paper: Can Blindfolded LLMs Still Trade? An Anonymization-First Framework for Portfolio Optimization
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of BlindTrade's anonymized four-agent signals, IC validation, reasoning-similarity graph, differential-Sharpe intent choice, and execution inertia; not the unreleased Gemini/SemGAT/PPO-DSR system or its daily S&P 500 Top-20 portfolio.

paper_source.bounded_release_search_checked_2026_09_0: Exact-title, arXiv-ID, paper-index, OpenReview, author-profile, GitHub, and Hugging Face evidence still exposes no attributable code, feature dataset, checkpoint, holdings, or result arrays.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Point-in-time anonymization removes identity shortcuts; Momentum, News-Event, Mean-Reversion, and Risk-Regime agents emit bounded structured scores using only prior information, followed by causal RankIC screening.
SemGAT connects same-sector and reasoning-similar stocks, uses two GATv2 layers, and predicts a distributional return ranking rather than a raw point estimate.
PPO-DSR chooses defensive, neutral, or aggressive intent from cross-sectional consensus, applies intent-dependent concentration, keeps only top-ranked equities, and smooths executions with inertia.
The four roles use price/volume momentum, anonymized news, overbought/oversold state, and beta/volatility/tail-risk inputs; the published primary inertia is 0.10 and cost is 10 bp per turnover.

blindtrade_policy.agent_reliability_rule: clip each trailing mean RankIC at zero, add 0.001, and renormalize before multiplying the selected intent weights
blindtrade_policy.semantic_graph_features: the four bounded anonymized agent scores stand in for structured reasoning embeddings
blindtrade_policy.intent_reward: trailing annualized mean divided by volatility of each candidate long-short decile sleeve, after 10 bp one-way turnover cost
blindtrade_policy.execution_rule: new score equals 0.10 proposed graph-policy score plus 0.90 prior score for a security observed in the immediately preceding month
blindtrade_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the inertial stock score enters frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six cost/missing-return paths

preserved_elements: four specialized Momentum, News-Event, Mean-Reversion, and Risk-Regime roles
cross-sectional IC validation using only realized history
defensive, neutral, and aggressive intent modes
approximated_elements: signed JKP price, earnings-surprise, reversal, and risk characteristics replace private RAW inputs
earnings and sales surprises replace unavailable anonymized headlines
deterministic role averages replace Gemini 2.5 Flash outputs and free-text reasoning
the four role-score vector replaces the 384-dimensional MiniLM reasoning embedding
cosine-neighbor averaging replaces learned sector-plus-semantic GATv2 attention
rolling RankIC reliability replaces the paper's holdout-selected LLM features
chronological trailing-Sharpe choice among three fixed intents replaces PPO-DSR
continuous inertial rank scores replace the equity-only Dirichlet Top-20 weights
the common monthly decile adapter replaces daily point-in-time S&P 500 execution
invented_elements: the exact JKP inputs and signs assigned to each role
the positive-IC reliability floor and normalization
the graph self and neighbor weights
long-short decile sleeves for intent reward
the score-level interpretation of the paper's 0.10 inertia
